title: The Baptism of Jesus Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Baptism of Jesus Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Baptism of Jesus Bible crossword: Jordan, the opened heavens, the dove, and the voice from heaven. KJV clues from Mark 1, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: He comes from Nazareth to a river where his cousin is baptizing, and John tries to talk him out of it. Then the heavens open, the Spirit descends like a dove, and a voice says something short. The Baptism of Jesus puts that scene into a grid.
It is a compact story, so the puzzle reaches either side of it — the wilderness before and the temptation after. The closing verse is the voice from heaven itself.

clues.text: River in which he was baptized
The Spirit descended in this likeness

verseText: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
